message.content: Rowan expressed that Cersei represents the idea that power comes with a significant cost. According to Rowan, Cersei achieved her goals but lost so much along the way, highlighting how pursuing power can isolate individuals and erode relationships. This sentiment resonates with broader themes of ambition and its consequences, suggesting that while Cersei may have attained the throne and a certain level of influence, she did so at the expense of her emotional well-being and the bonds she held dear.
